title: Unitarity, Recursion and Soft Limits in (EA)dS through Dressing
summary: Using the recently developed framework in which cosmological correlators in (E)AdS are represented as flat-space amplitudes dressed by auxiliary propagators, we show that several structural properties of the cosmological observables have a direct flat-space origin. We derive cosmological cutting rules for spinning correlators from the flat-space optical theorem, obtain the cosmological tree theorem from the Feynman tree theorem, and uplift BCFW recursion relations to (E)AdS via dressing.
